name: Ezaki Seren
source:
The former deputy director at Ryugu. A prisoner at The End, as well as the CEO of Prison Temp.

[spoiler]She is the mastermind of the heretic attack on Ryugu. She digitally copied the consciousness of Ku Otsuki and implanted it into her right eye.[/spoiler]
